2607.28109.title: Beyond Rephrasing: Book-Level Organization Improves Synthetic Textbook Data for Mid-Training
2607.28109.paper_summary: Synthetic textbook data has improved language model pre-training, but prior work largely treats the benefit as a property of generated content or local rewriting style. We study a different factor: whether related content is organized into coherent book-level documents. We contribute both a scalable synthesis pipeline and controlled evidence that this organization matters. The pipeline retrieves source material from a pre-training corpus, clusters it into topical units, plans hierarchical tables of contents, and assembles source-grounded sections into complete books (our Full setting), yielding 686K textbooks (32B tokens) across 15,000+ disciplines. Replacing natural books in a mid-training mix with this corpus improves downstream performance by +1.09 on average. Controlled comparisons then disentangle the relevant design factors. A content-matched Split condition holds generated text and tokens fixed but treats each section as an independent document; Full's +1.02 mean gain isolates document packaging. A length-matched RandomConcat control that joins sections from different books remains below Full, ruling out document length alone. A retrieval-pool-matched Rephrase condition independently rewrites individual retrieved documents under the same audience-by-style scheme, without clustering, TOC planning, or book assembly; Full's +1.17 gain demonstrates the value of structured synthesis. On Llama3-8B, Full likewise outperforms both RandomConcat and Natural Books, supporting book-level organization as a useful axis for synthetic pre-training data design.
2607.28109.paper_summary_zh: 合成教科書數據改善了語言模型的預訓練，但先前的研究主要將這種好處視為生成內容或局部重寫風格的特性。<lb/>我們研究了一個不同的因素：相關內容是否組織成連貫的書籍級文檔。<lb/>我們貢獻了一個可擴展的合成管道和受控證據，證明這種組織是重要的。<lb/>該管道從預訓練語料庫中檢索源材料，將其聚類為主題單元，規劃分層的內容表，並將基於來源的部分組裝成完整的書籍（我們的完整設置），產生了686K本教科書（32B個標記），涵蓋15,000多個學科。<lb/>用這個語料庫替換中期訓練混合中的自然書籍，平均提高下游性能+1.09。<lb/>受控比較然後解開相關的設計因素。<lb/>內容匹配的拆分條件保持生成文本和標記固定，但將每個部分視為獨立文檔；完整的+1.02平均增益孤立了文檔包裝。<lb/>一個長度匹配的隨機串聯控制將來自不同書籍的部分連接在一起，仍然低於完整，排除了僅文檔長度的影響。<lb/>一個檢索池匹配的改寫條件在相同的受眾風格方案下獨立重寫個別檢索的文檔，沒有聚類、內容表規劃或書籍組裝；完整的+1.17增益證明了結構化合成的價值。<lb/>在Llama3-8B上，完整同樣超越了隨機串聯和自然書籍，支持書籍級組織作為合成預訓練數據設計的一個有用軸心。
